sentence: Over time, I came to love this city.
zh-TW: 隨著時間過去，我漸漸愛上了這座城市。
tagging_notes: come to 在此為「逐漸變得」

sentence: I ordered a burger along with some fries.
zh-TW: 我點了一個漢堡，還有一些薯條。

sentence: It may well rain later, so take an umbrella.
zh-TW: 晚一點很可能會下雨，帶把傘吧。

sentence: Get out of the car and stretch your legs.
zh-TW: 下車伸展一下雙腿吧。

sentence: We had lunch, followed by a walk in the park.
zh-TW: 我們吃了午餐，接著去公園散步。

sentence: I'm lucky in that my office is close to home.
zh-TW: 我很幸運，因為我的辦公室離家很近。
tagging_notes: in that 在此為「就…而言；因為」

sentence: If that's the case, we should leave now.
zh-TW: 如果真是那樣，我們應該現在就走。
tagging_notes: the case 在此為「事實；實情」

sentence: My dad took up golf after he retired.
zh-TW: 我爸退休後開始打高爾夫球。
tagging_notes: take up 在此為「開始從事」

sentence: Rent and food account for most of my spending.
zh-TW: 房租和食物佔了我大部分的開銷。
tagging_notes: account for 在此為「佔（比例）」

sentence: We set out early to avoid the traffic.
zh-TW: 我們很早出發，以避開車潮。
tagging_notes: set out 在此為「出發」

sentence: As far as I know, the store opens at ten.
zh-TW: 據我所知，那家店十點開門。
tagging_notes: as far as 在此為「就…而言」

sentence: This class is concerned with basic writing skills.
zh-TW: 這門課的重點在基本寫作技巧。

sentence: I was about to call you.
zh-TW: 我正要打電話給你。

sentence: We're supposed to check out by noon.
zh-TW: 我們應該在中午前退房。
tagging_notes: supposed to 在此為「應該」

sentence: Bring a towel, sunscreen, water, and so on.
zh-TW: 帶毛巾、防曬乳、水等等。

sentence: Come on, we're going to be late!
zh-TW: 快點，我們要遲到了！
tagging_notes: come on 在此為「快點」

sentence: I can't take on any more work this week.
zh-TW: 這星期我沒辦法再接更多工作了。
tagging_notes: take on 在此為「承擔」

sentence: Don't worry, everything worked out fine.
zh-TW: 別擔心，一切都順利解決了。
tagging_notes: work out 在此為「結果變成（順利）」

sentence: There were toys all over the floor.
zh-TW: 地上到處都是玩具。
tagging_notes: all over 在此為「到處」

sentence: I don't eat meat other than chicken.
zh-TW: 除了雞肉，我不吃其他肉。

sentence: Nine out of ten people liked the new design.
zh-TW: 十個人裡有九個喜歡新設計。
tagging_notes: out of 在此為「在…之中」

sentence: The weather turned out to be perfect.
zh-TW: 結果天氣好得不得了。
tagging_notes: turn out 在此為「結果是」

sentence: Can you look after my cat this weekend?
zh-TW: 你這個週末可以幫我照顧貓嗎？

sentence: At last, the bus is here!
zh-TW: 公車終於來了！

sentence: The café offers a variety of cakes.
zh-TW: 這家咖啡店提供各式各樣的蛋糕。

sentence: At first, I didn't like my new job.
zh-TW: 一開始，我不喜歡我的新工作。

sentence: The train leaves in ten minutes or so.
zh-TW: 火車大約十分鐘後開。

sentence: Most of us are in favour of the plan.
zh-TW: 我們大多數人都贊成這個計畫。

sentence: Don't give up, you're almost there.
zh-TW: 別放棄，你快成功了。

sentence: How do I get to the train station?
zh-TW: 請問火車站怎麼去？
tagging_notes: get to 在此為「到達」

sentence: I found myself smiling at the message.
zh-TW: 看到那則訊息，我發現自己在微笑。
tagging_notes: find oneself 用過去式 found myself

sentence: What time do you usually get up?
zh-TW: 你通常幾點起床？

sentence: Carry on, I'm listening.
zh-TW: 繼續說，我在聽。

sentence: I want to go back to Japan someday.
zh-TW: 我想要有一天再回日本。

sentence: I need to focus on my exams this month.
zh-TW: 這個月我需要專心準備考試。

sentence: Please call me at once if anything changes.
zh-TW: 如果有任何變化，請馬上打給我。
tagging_notes: at once 在此為「立刻」

sentence: It takes about an hour to get there by train.
zh-TW: 搭火車去那裡大約要一個小時。

sentence: We need to get off at the next stop.
zh-TW: 我們要在下一站下車。
tagging_notes: 詞表為 get on/off，此句用 get off

sentence: The team as a whole did a great job.
zh-TW: 團隊整體表現得很好。

sentence: In practice, the rule is rarely followed.
zh-TW: 實際上，這條規定很少人遵守。

sentence: By the time we arrived, the movie had started.
zh-TW: 我們到的時候，電影已經開始了。

sentence: There are lots of good restaurants around here.
zh-TW: 這附近有很多好餐廳。

sentence: This place is said to be the best in town.
zh-TW: 據說這家店是鎮上最好的。

sentence: We got to the airport just in time.
zh-TW: 我們剛好及時趕到機場。

sentence: Each student will speak in turn.
zh-TW: 每個學生會輪流發言。
tagging_notes: in turn 在此為「依次」

sentence: Thank you once again for your help.
zh-TW: 再次感謝你的幫忙。

sentence: My little brother asks questions all the time.
zh-TW: 我弟弟一天到晚都在問問題。

sentence: Seats are given on the basis of arrival time.
zh-TW: 座位依照抵達時間分配。

sentence: I'm kind of tired today.
zh-TW: 我今天有點累。
tagging_notes: kind of 在此為「有點」

sentence: I don't want to get into the habit of snacking late.
zh-TW: 我不想養成很晚吃零食的習慣。
tagging_notes: get into 在此為「養成（習慣）」

sentence: You can always rely on Lisa.
zh-TW: 你永遠可以依靠 Lisa。

sentence: I think I'll go for the fish.
zh-TW: 我想我要點魚。
tagging_notes: go for 在此為「選擇」

sentence: We aim to reply within 24 hours.
zh-TW: 我們的目標是在 24 小時內回覆。

sentence: Women make up half of our staff.
zh-TW: 我們的員工有一半是女性。
tagging_notes: make up 在此為「組成」

sentence: This game should appeal to young kids.
zh-TW: 這款遊戲應該會吸引年紀小的孩子。
tagging_notes: appeal to 在此為「吸引」

sentence: We ended up eating at home.
zh-TW: 我們最後在家吃飯。

sentence: He just shook his head and smiled.
zh-TW: 他只是搖搖頭，笑了笑。
tagging_notes: shake one's head 用過去式 shook his head

sentence: The walk takes no more than ten minutes.
zh-TW: 走路只要十分鐘以內。
tagging_notes: no more than 在此為「僅僅；不超過」

sentence: What time will you get back tonight?
zh-TW: 你今晚幾點回來？
tagging_notes: get back 在此為「回來」

sentence: What about Friday? Are you free then?
zh-TW: 星期五怎麼樣？你那時有空嗎？

sentence: In other words, we need more time.
zh-TW: 換句話說，我們需要更多時間。

sentence: As for dessert, I'll skip it tonight.
zh-TW: 至於甜點，我今晚就不吃了。

sentence: I'm not even hungry.
zh-TW: 我根本就不餓。

sentence: You're entitled to a full refund.
zh-TW: 你有權獲得全額退款。

sentence: Prior to the meeting, please read this report.
zh-TW: 開會前，請先看這份報告。

sentence: She chose to study abroad.
zh-TW: 她選擇出國念書。

sentence: The tickets cost something like fifty dollars.
zh-TW: 票價大概五十美元左右。
tagging_notes: something like 在此為「大約」

sentence: This road is known to flood in heavy rain.
zh-TW: 大家都知道這條路下大雨就會淹水。

sentence: Let's keep in touch after graduation.
zh-TW: 畢業後我們保持聯絡吧。

sentence: In the end, we decided to stay home.
zh-TW: 最後，我們決定待在家。

sentence: Sorry, am I in the way?
zh-TW: 抱歉，我擋到你了嗎？

sentence: Would you care for some tea?
zh-TW: 你想喝點茶嗎？
tagging_notes: care for 在此為「喜歡；想要」

sentence: In the event of a fire, use the stairs.
zh-TW: 萬一發生火災，請走樓梯。

sentence: They say this winter will be very cold.
zh-TW: 聽說今年冬天會很冷。

sentence: This so-called sale isn't really cheaper.
zh-TW: 這個所謂的特價其實沒有比較便宜。
tagging_notes: 句中寫作 so-called

sentence: We need to take into account the travel time.
zh-TW: 我們需要把交通時間考慮進去。

sentence: There is no charge in respect of children under five.
zh-TW: 五歲以下兒童不收費。

sentence: This bag is made out of old jeans.
zh-TW: 這個包包是用舊牛仔褲做的。
tagging_notes: out of 在此為「用…製成」

sentence: It's a great job. At the same time, the hours are long.
zh-TW: 這是份好工作，但同時工時也很長。
tagging_notes: at the same time 在此為「然而」

sentence: The bank is next to the post office.
zh-TW: 銀行在郵局旁邊。

sentence: Only five people turned up to the party.
zh-TW: 只有五個人來參加派對。
tagging_notes: turn up 在此為「出現；到場」

sentence: I understand your point of view.
zh-TW: 我了解你的觀點。

sentence: At present, the shop is closed for repairs.
zh-TW: 目前這家店因整修而暫停營業。

sentence: I'm not used to spicy food yet.
zh-TW: 我還不習慣吃辣。
tagging_notes: used to 在此為「習慣於」

sentence: I'm not sure whether or not he's coming.
zh-TW: 我不確定他會不會來。

sentence: Everything is in place for the event.
zh-TW: 活動的一切都準備就緒了。

sentence: No doubt you'll do well on the test.
zh-TW: 你考試肯定會考得很好。
tagging_notes: no doubt 在此為「無疑；肯定」

sentence: My sister works full time at a hospital.
zh-TW: 我姊姊在醫院做全職工作。

sentence: Let me sort out these papers first.
zh-TW: 我先把這些文件整理好。
tagging_notes: sort out 在此為「整理」

sentence: In a way, I'm glad it happened.
zh-TW: 在某種程度上，我很慶幸這件事發生了。

sentence: Let's grab a coffee or something.
zh-TW: 我們去喝杯咖啡什麼的吧。

sentence: I'm calling on behalf of my manager.
zh-TW: 我代表我的經理打電話來。

sentence: The restrooms are over there.
zh-TW: 洗手間在那邊。

sentence: In spite of the rain, we had fun.
zh-TW: 儘管下雨，我們還是玩得很開心。

sentence: That's it for today, see you tomorrow.
zh-TW: 今天就到這裡，明天見。

sentence: The delay was in part due to the weather.
zh-TW: 延誤部分是因為天氣。

sentence: Oh no, I left my phone at home!
zh-TW: 噢不，我把手機忘在家裡了！

sentence: Do you have any place in mind for dinner?
zh-TW: 晚餐你有想去的地方嗎？

sentence: I'm writing with regard to my order.
zh-TW: 我來信是關於我的訂單。

sentence: The neighbors help one another a lot.
zh-TW: 鄰居們經常互相幫忙。
